title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 4: the widow's oil, the Shunammite and her son, the death in the pot and the bread that fed a hundred men.

questions.text: What had the creditor come to do to the widow of one of the sons of the prophets?
questions.explanation: The widow told Elisha that the creditor had come to take her two children to be his slaves.

answers.text: Take her two children to be slaves
Take her house and her field
Throw her into prison
Take her husband's cattle

questions.text: What did the widow have in her house?
questions.explanation: She said, 'Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.'

answers.text: A little flour in a jar
Two loaves of barley bread
Nothing except a pot of oil
Only a few pieces of silver

questions.text: When did the oil stop flowing?
questions.explanation: When the containers were full, her son said there was not another container, and then the oil stopped flowing.

answers.text: When the sun went down
When there was not another container
When the neighbors came to look
When Elisha arrived at the house

questions.text: What did the prominent woman of Shunem suggest making for Elisha?
questions.explanation: She said, 'Please let's make a little room on the roof,' with a bed, a table, a chair and a lamp stand for him.

answers.text: A tent beside the house
A new garment and sandals
A seat by the city gate
A little room on the roof

questions.text: What did Gehazi point out about the Shunammite woman?
questions.explanation: Gehazi answered, 'Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.'

answers.text: She was a widow living alone
She had no son and her husband was old
She owed money to a creditor
She was ill and could not walk

questions.text: What did the child say to his father among the reapers?
questions.explanation: The child said to his father, 'My head! My head!' and his father had him carried to his mother.

answers.text: My head! My head!
I am thirsty!
My feet hurt!
I am afraid!

questions.text: What did Elisha tell Gehazi to lay on the child's face?
questions.explanation: Elisha told Gehazi to take his staff and lay it on the child's face.

answers.text: His mantle
His belt
A wet cloth
His staff

questions.text: What did the child do after Elisha stretched himself out on him a second time?
questions.explanation: The child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

answers.text: He sat up and asked for food
He cried out for his mother
He sneezed seven times and opened his eyes
He stood up and walked outside

questions.text: What did Elisha throw into the pot of stew that had death in it?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'Then bring meal,' threw it into the pot, and there was nothing harmful in the pot.

answers.text: Meal
Salt
Herbs
Oil

questions.text: What did the man from Baal Shalishah bring to the man of God?
questions.explanation: A man from Baal Shalishah brought the man of God bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack.

answers.text: A skin of wine and dried figs
Twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain
A young goat and a basket of fruit
Ten loaves of wheat and a jar of honey
